name: stargira-tieout
description: Builds a three-statement financial model (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) in Excel: a SaaS business, a power project, a business that earns on a balance it holds, or a listed company, bank or insurer built from its own SEC (US) or EDINET (Japan) filings. Every workbook opens on a Start_Here guide, every input sits on one Assumptions sheet, every other cell is a formula, and a checker confirms the statements tie out in every period.
